description: This file defines a utility enum `GatewayDeviceAuthPayload` with functions to build authentication payload strings for devices, normalize metadata fields, and create signed device dictionaries, primarily used for device authentication procedures in the application.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Constructs a version 3 device authentication payload string by concatenating various device and scope information separated by '|'.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes a string metadata field by trimming whitespace, converting ASCII uppercase to lowercase, and handling nil or empty values.

methods.name: signedDeviceDictionary
methods.description: Creates a dictionary containing signed device information, including the device ID, public key, signature, timestamp, and nonce, using external signing and key retrieval methods.
